chunks.text: Mahsa Rezaei — Future of Work Architect, Tech-Driven Social Impact Leader, TEDx Speaker. Founder of Intelligent Nest and MamaNest. Host of Her Career Conference 2026. Session: Opening Keynote — Intelligent Nest and MamaNest (May 30, 2:15-2:45 PM). Key topics: women in tech, career transition, AI economy, Intelligent Nest ecosystem, future of work.
Lianna Della Vecchia — Education and Program Design Specialist. Session: Welcome and Opening at Her Career Conference 2026, May 30, 2:00-2:15 PM at District3.

Jeffrey To — Psychology PhD candidate and public speaking coach for tech professionals. Session: Speed Networking Activity, May 30, 2:45-3:15 PM at District3. Jeffrey facilitates the interactive speed networking session, helping attendees make meaningful connections.

Lin Sok — Tech Founder and Community Builder. Panelist at Her Career Conference 2026. Session: Panel Discussion — Women, Work & What's Next: Navigating the Future of Work, May 30, 3:30-4:30 PM at District3.

Dominique Pirolo — IBM and Ex-SAP Talent Leader. Panelist at Her Career Conference 2026. Session: Panel Discussion — Women, Work & What's Next: Navigating the Future of Work, May 30, 3:30-4:30 PM at District3.

Samantha Bateman — Executive Recruiter and Founder of Integria Consulting. Panelist at Her Career Conference 2026. Session: Panel Discussion — Women, Work & What's Next: Navigating the Future of Work, May 30, 3:30-4:30 PM at District3.

Rachel Beyerlein — Career Lead at Le Wagon. Panelist at Her Career Conference 2026. Session: Panel Discussion — Women, Work & What's Next: Navigating the Future of Work, May 30, 3:30-4:30 PM at District3.

Stefania Pecore — Executive Director of Women Techmakers Montreal. AI Expert and Strategy Development Partner. Session: Closing Keynote, May 30, 4:30-4:50 PM at District3. Her career began with the introduction of the first AI and automatic translation subject at an Italian university. She holds a master's and Ph.D. in Computer Science, with expertise in NLP and AI across education and video games. She is an ambassador for Women Techmakers, Women in AI, and Women in Games. Under her leadership, Women Techmakers Montreal grew from 150 to over 400 attendees. She is an AI Expert for UNESCO Women4Ethical AI program and an Ethical AI Expert Without Borders.

Prisca Onyebuchi — AI Strategy Advisor. Workshop 1: AI-Ready for Your Career — Turning Fear into Opportunity. June 1, 2026, 12:00-1:00 PM, online. Helps women overcome fear of AI and discover how to use it as a career opportunity.

Farshad Rouhani — AI Strategy Advisor. Human-AI Venture Architect, Business Advisor, AI Career Strategy Expert. Workshop 2: From AI-Assisted to AI-Native — Career Strategy. June 2, 2026, 4:00-5:00 PM, online. He coaches founders and leaders through the shift from AI-assisted work to AI-native organizations.

Ysimer (Ysi) Gonzalez — Founder of Vantelira Inc., Industrial Engineer, Lean Six Sigma Green Belt. Workshop 3: The Experimentation Habit — The Skill That Future-Proofs You. June 3, 2026, 4:00-5:00 PM, online. She spent 18 years managing Fortune 500 supply chains at ABB, Pratt and Whitney, and Bombardier. Her philosophy: process before tools, always.

Marie-Claire Asseko — Digital Strategy and AI Consultant. Founder of The Kaizen Gal and Meneva Digital. Workshop 4: Agility and AI Literacy — A Non-Linear Learning Path. June 4, 2026, 4:00-5:00 PM, online. Over a decade of experience in SaaS, go-to-market strategy, and business process optimization. Born in Central Africa, based in Montreal.

Natalie Loop — Founder and CEO of Alygra, a boutique fractional advisory firm helping tech startups build HR, legal, and AI infrastructure to scale. Workshop 5: From Employee to Architect — Portfolio Career in the Age of AI. June 5, 2026, 4:00-5:00 PM, online. Over 15 years of experience across startups, scale-ups, and global firms.
